about: Shared by the page's tests (web/disc-identity.test.mjs, web/disc-zip.test.mjs) and the server's (server/test/disc-identity.test.ts). Written by server/scripts/disc-fixtures.py, whose identities follow the Python launcher's algorithm. files[0] is the CUE; a track's file may be named otherwise than the CUE spells it. Each archive gives the identity of the disc it was made from, or names the page's refusal (DiscZipError.code). Synthetic bytes only; no fixture has the PAL flag, which needs the real first data track.
